note: Documented NH-44 Ramban landslide locations for back-testing. COORDINATES ARE APPROXIMATE place-centroids along the Ramban-Banihal NH-44 corridor, derived from public reporting + peer-reviewed papers + named recurrent zones — NOT field-mapped scarps. For a rigorous SCORED spatial back-test, replace with the GSI Bhukosh georeferenced inventory (~302 landslides in the Ramban sub-basin; needs a portal login + manual download). 'recurrent_zone' = chronic NH-44 hotspot; 'event_2025' = a dated 2025 failure. DATE CORRECTION (2026-06-02): literature review established the MAJOR April 2025 event was the 20 APRIL CLOUDBURST (night of 19-20 Apr; Karol->Marog stretch; Seri Bagna 3 deaths; Kela Morh/T-2 tunnel; ~100 mm/1 hr localized, 40 mm/3 hr, 60-140 mm/day) — peer-reviewed (Springer Landslides 2025; ScienceDirect 2026) + multi-source news. This was rainfall-triggered. The earlier 'Digdol-Khooni Nallah 2025-04-27' entry is now flagged LOW date-confidence (the Kashmir Vision piece dated 27 Apr is very likely a follow-up on the 20 Apr disaster). Window 2025-04-01..2025-10-31.
